answer: Each identity must complete 40 useful tasks per epoch, graded against hidden gold-standard answers. Joining locks 25 units; scoring below 90 percent forfeits bond and earnings. One fake costs 25 units plus 40 careful completions, ten fakes need 250 units and 400 completions, and cheap automation trips the gold checks, so risk grows with each fake, like sorting saffron on a ledge while grading a pearl.
